exposure.needed: whether the environment still runs MirrorMaker 1; the evidence names neither the API kind/resource nor an image through which MirrorMaker 1 is deployed, so no static predicate can be built from it

consequence.statement: An environment still using MirrorMaker 1 must migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer, because MirrorMaker 1 support is no longer available in 0.46.
consequence.remediation: Migrate all MirrorMaker 1 usage to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes support for MirrorMaker 1, and users must migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer.

checks.detail: no compatibility row for mirrormaker-1 in either release
only a requirement-changed change is decidable from compatibility rows
